author: Elfiiss
quote: I have played this game for the sole reason of the 99 rating. This game is very buggy, the 30 FPS is just hard to look at, and the graphics are really foggy. This does not even matter if the game was actually fun. First, the writing in this game is bland, the complex characters that we got from older GTA titles, are not in any of the new characters, I found myself not enjoying the dialogue at all, just super boring. Second, I love flying in GTA, they made it so airplanes do not blow up?? Even if you turn off the setting that protects vehicles, your plane bounces off boats and buildings more than it actually takes damage, this censorship is in the writing and a lot of NPCs that have nothing do with quests you can not kill. Third, this is not GTA, they should have called it a different title altogether and marketed as its own game, Grand Theft Auto is all about killing who you want, committing crimes, and doing whatever whenever, this game does not want you to do any of that, you are forced to do mundane tasks, not kill because its bad, and just pushed away from crime activity in general. Do not buy this game please, it would just reinforce that they can get away with this slop.
